subject: Launch economics matchmaking & ops roadmap
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@acme-ml.com>, Samir Patel <samir@coral.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Launch economics matchmaking & ops roadmap

Hi Claire / Samir,

Great to meet you both over the call earlier. I wanted to capture a lightweight kickoff plan so we can hit the ground running on the cost/performance work during implementation. Goal: identify the practical levers (batching, prefix/KV caching, quantization profile candidates, and routing fallbacks) that will reduce per-token unit cost while keeping p95 latency within your target (<= 350ms).

Proposed 30–45 min matchmaking session next week to align owners and initial experiments. Draft agenda: 
- 10m: current traffic shape & SLAs (Claire)
- 10m: Redwood runtime options & quick wins (Jordan)
- 15m: owner assignments + 2-week experiment plan (Marissa/Priyom owners)

I've attached a short kickoff worksheet (kickoff-worksheet.xlsx) to collect peak seq length, typical prompt/response lengths, and sample QPS windows. Can you fill the top section before the session? Also, if you can share a short snapshot of production traffic, that will help us recommend quant profiles.

Next steps: propose 3 time slots — Tue/Wed/Thu morning PST. I can lead the matchmaking and Marissa will run the first batching experiment once we agree scope. Priyom will propose quantization variants that match your accuracy constraints.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kickoff-worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Claire Huang <claire@acme-ml.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@coral.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch economics matchmaking & ops roadmap

Thanks Jordan — this looks good. We're excited to optimize before we flip traffic. A couple quick notes while I populate the worksheet: 

- Attaching a small traffic snapshot (prod-traffic-snapshot.csv) showing 7-day QPS and a few percentile lengths. Peak QPS around 120 in our EU region, but initial rollout will be US.
- Our primary SLO is p95 <= 350ms for conversational flows; batch-friendly async jobs can tolerate 1–2s.
- Accuracy: we need < 2% regression on our intent classification eval when evaluating quant/opt variants.

We can do Tue 10:00am PST for the session — Samir and I will both be there. I'll pre-fill the worksheet with top-line numbers.

Claire Huang
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme ML

Attachments: prod-traffic-snapshot.csv (CSV)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Launch economics matchmaking & ops roadmap

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Claire's snapshot and the worksheet they will fill. Quick internal alignment before Tue at 10am PST: 

On Sat, 11 Dec 2027 at 09:18, Claire Huang <claire@acme-ml.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jordan — this looks good...
> (see prod-traffic-snapshot.csv)

Proposed split of responsibilities: 
- Marissa: own batching experiments and prefix caching validation. Start with two batch window configs (small: dynamic per-request batching target 8ms wait cap; large: 50ms cap) and measure p50/p95 token latency + throughput. Deliverable: experiment runbook + CSV results by Fri 17 Dec.
- Priyom: propose 2 quantization profile candidates (4-bit NLQ, 8-bit dynamic) and run WER/intent-regression checks vs their eval set. Provide a short doc (quant-options.md) with expected memory/throughput tradeoffs by Wed 15 Dec.
- Jordan: coordinate routing policy options — warm/colder model variants and fallback rules in case dedicated capacity spikes.

Risks to call out for the meeting: potential quality regression from aggressive quant; long-tail latency when batching under low QPS. We'll present mitigations and guardrails.

Attachments: quant-options.md (draft)

Thanks — see you Tue.

Jordan
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@acme-ml.com>, Samir Patel <samir@coral.ai>

Date: Mon, 12 Dec 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch economics matchmaking & ops roadmap — confirmed + MAP

Thanks again for confirming the slot. Quick recap and mutual action plan before Tue: 

Meeting: Tue 14 Dec 2027 • 10:00–10:45am PST (Zoom link in calendar invite)

Mutual action plan (owners / due dates):
1) Fill kickoff worksheet — Claire (done before meeting) — Claire indicated will be pre-filled.
2) Batching baseline & experiment runbook — Marissa — deliver by 2027-12-17 (CSV results + short analysis).
3) Quantization candidates & eval results — Priyom — deliver by 2027-12-15 (quant-options.md + regression numbers).
4) Routing policy options & fallback diagram — Jordan — deliver by 2027-12-18 (short doc + config snippets).
5) Follow-up pilot schedule (2-week pilot) — decision in meeting; target pilot start 2027-12-20 if agreed.

High-level success criteria: reduce per-token cost by at least 25% vs baseline while keeping intent regression < 2% and p95 <= 350ms after deployment.

If there are additional folks from your infra side who should join (networking, security), let me know and I'll add them. See attached pointers and the Drive folder for pre-reads. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
